card_text: Three haircut services for anyone driving down from Artesia: which to book and how to fit the trip around work.

seo.title: Men's Haircuts for Artesia, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Men's haircuts for Artesia, cut by Tim in Carlsbad about 44 minutes south on US 285. Which of the three services to book and how to fit it around work.

paragraphs: Three haircut services, all cut by me in Carlsbad, not in Artesia. The shop sits {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles south on {{city:artesia.route}}, about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes door to door (OpenStreetMap routing), the closest of the three cities on these pages.
Below: which of the three to book, how the drive fits a work week, and when to set the next one.

blocks.heading: Cuts that survive a hard hat.
paragraphs: In Artesia, {{city:artesia.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} of jobs are in mining, oil and gas or agriculture (Census ACS 2023). If that's your week, you want hair that holds under a hard hat and asks nothing of you in the morning: the Essential Haircut, my shortest full service.
Another {{city:artesia.age_20_34_pct}} of Artesia is between 20 and 34 (Census ACS 2023). At that age a lined-up beard is often part of the ask, which is the Signature Cut.
Saturday runs 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. If a rotation eats your weekdays, an early Saturday slot gets you cut and back on 285 with most of the day still ahead of you.

blocks.heading: Decide before you leave Artesia.
blocks.lead: Prices and times from my Booksy menu. Add about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes each way.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The cut by itself: shaped to your head, straight razor on the neckline, a quick style, done. Book it when the beard isn't part of the visit.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Adds a beard trim or line-up and closes with a hot towel. One drive from Artesia takes care of the hair and the beard together.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Cut, beard sculpt, wash and scalp massage, steam, two hot towels, a basic design and more. If you're driving down anyway, this booking uses the trip fully.

blocks.heading: Set the next one before you go.
paragraphs: A {{city:artesia.drive_min}}-minute drive is short, but not short enough to make for a cut that's already past the point you liked. Pick the gap that suits your hair and put the next date on Booksy while you're still in the chair.

items.q: Which haircut should I book if I work in the oilfield?
items.a: Any of the three. Short and easy: the Essential Haircut. Beard needs lining up too: the Signature Cut. Mention the hard hat when you sit down and we'll talk through how short to go on the sides.

items.q: How long is the drive from Artesia?
items.a: About {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes and {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles down {{city:artesia.route}} to {{address}}.

items.q: Can I come after work on a weekday?
items.a: Weekday appointments are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday; Booksy shows the latest open time each day. Wednesday and Sunday I'm closed.
Yes. I only cut by appointment, so grab a time on Booksy before you head down. The haircuts page has the full menu.

blocks.heading:
Book the cut.
Then head south on 285.
